retrievalProfile.description: A dense, modular grid collage combining high-contrast monochrome portraits with vibrant psychedelic symbols and physical textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, multi-panel composition structured on an irregular grid. It features a mix of high-contrast black-and-white portraiture, organic elements like dried flowers and nests, mechanical gears, and bold psychedelic graphic symbols. The color palette is dominated by warm oranges, reds, and yellows, contrasted against stark monochrome photography and deep black borders.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based modularity vs. organic overlapping elements
High-contrast monochrome faces vs. saturated warm-toned graphics
Mechanical precision (gears, clocks) vs. natural fragility (flowers, birds)
Flat graphic symbols vs. three-dimensional found objects
coreInvariants: Warm orange and red color foundation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale portrait occupies the bottom right quadrant, balanced by a dense cluster of smaller, varied modules across the rest of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large face in the bottom right and the central white bird silhouette act as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves in a zig-zag pattern across the grid, jumping between high-contrast B&W elements and bright red/yellow focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a 'horror vacui' style collage with very little unoccupied area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Ochre and Burnt Orange (background and graphic fills)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black and Stark White (photographic elements)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red and Golden Yellow (geometric shapes and flowers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic areas meets high value contrast in photographic areas.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens except as very minor accents

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with extreme contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters that warp to fit rectangular containers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix warped psychedelic display lettering with small, typewriter-style or sans-serif metadata text.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the authentic 1960s concert poster aesthetic
Provides the organic skeleton for the warped lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a modular grid collage featuring high-contrast B&W portraits, dried yellow flowers, mechanical gears, a white bird silhouette, and orange/red geometric shapes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom-drawn, warped psychedelic lettering in a vertical orientation within one of the lower-left grid cells using a black fill on a yellow background.

verificationChecks: Color palette is restricted to warm tones and monochrome
Lettering is warped and integrated into the grid
Mix of photographic and graphic textures is present

adjustableVariables: Ratio of photography to graphic symbols
Intensity of the orange/red color cast
mustRedesign: Specific faces to avoid likeness issues
Unique lettering to avoid existing brand marks
Specific found objects like the nest or gears
postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical collage?
Is the large portrait in the bottom right balanced by the grid?
Are the warm tones consistent across the graphic elements?
Is the typography sufficiently warped and psychedelic?
recipe.reuseFormula: Modular grid + [Warm Palette] + [High-Contrast B&W Portraits] + [Psychedelic Symbols] + [Warped Vertical Lettering] = 1960s Collage Aesthetic
